posts.name: Under3
posts.cooked:
Yes, I too definitely agree with Silverleaf on this. The representation is amazing and one of my favourite aspects of both the game and the company but some more body type variety, especially for female characters, wouldn’t go amiss.
Mindphyre being a good example of this, she’s not a physical fighter and doesn’t need to be athletic, so in theory could have had any body type, which is then shown up further by the huge variety of body types among the male clones. Likewise even Akash’Bhuta, while clearly quite monstrous, often strays towards the stereotypical female comic book body shape. Those are probably the main two I think of that could be prime candidates for body variety.
At the same time totally have to call out Kaargra for doing it well, that is one impressively muscled beast of a body there.
